summary: feat(settings): sign in to Sync with a PRF passkey and no password
description:
Because:
- A passkey with a stored wrap can recover kB in the browser.

This commit:
- Fetches and opens the wrap after a PRF passkey sign-in and passes kB into the OAuth flow.
- Sends every wrap-less or failing case to the password page.
- Stashes opt-in material only when no usable wrap is stored.
- Reports a wrap that will not open to Sentry, since no retry can clear it.
- Skips the wrap path outside OAuth-native Sync and when the flag is off.

Closes #FXA-13152
